parole.significato: A beaver-like rodent found on the west coast of North America (Aplodontia rufa).
parole.testo: From a misunderstanding by Lewis and Clark of Chinook sewellel, shewellel, which actually denotes a robe made from pelt of this rodent rather than the rodent itself.

parole.significato: A member of a Native American tribe from Oregon.
parole.testo: From Chinook T-Elim-ook, meaning something like 'the many villages of Elim'.

parole.significato: A tribal chief of the Chinookan peoples in the Pacific Northwest of the United States.
